FAQ

1
What channels are supported within each of Buffer's tools?

The table below lists the supported channels for Buffer's Publish, Analyze, and Engage tools:

Supported channels

Facebook Pages Yes ✅ Yes ✅ Yes ✅
Facebook Groups Yes ✅ No No
Instagram business accounts Yes ✅ Yes ✅ Yes ✅
Twitter profiles Yes ✅ Yes ✅ No
LinkedIn Pages Yes ✅ Yes ✅ No
LinkedIn profiles Yes ✅ No No
Pinterest business accounts Yes ✅ No No
Shopify stores No Yes ✅ No
TikTok business accounts Yes ✅ No No
Google business profiles Yes ✅ No No
Start Pages Yes ✅ No No
Mastodon Yes ✅ No No
2
Who is the Buffer Free plan ideal for?

The Free plan is ideal for individual users who want to schedule content to up to three channels.

3
What does the Buffer Essentials plan offer?

The Essentials plan is better suited for scheduling content to a brand's social channels and provides access to Buffer's advanced analytics and engagement tools.

4
Who should consider the Buffer Team plan?

The Team plan is best for teams who want to collaborate on their social media posts and unlocks the ability to invite unlimited team members. However, it's not limited to teams only. Even if you're a solo social media marketer who needs someone to approve posts, the Team plan can be useful for getting your drafts approved. So, if you need help with approvals or want to collaborate with others on your social media content, the Team plan could be a great fit for you.

5
What is the Buffer Agency plan?

The Agency plan is for organizations or individuals who want to connect 10 or more social channels and provides all the features of both the Essentials and Team plans at a lower price point. Agency plans start at $120 per month for up to 10 channels. Any additional channels connected after 10 would be priced at $6 a month (or $60 a year) instead of $12.

6
What are the billing options for Buffer's plans?

You can choose to pay for your plan on a monthly or annual basis. Opting for the annual billing option comes with a discount. You can switch between these two options at any time. In the event that you switch billing frequencies, we will make prorations and refunds as necessary.

7
What payment methods does Buffer accept?

Buffer accepts credit and debit card payments from Visa, Mastercard, American Express, JCB, Discover, and Diners Club. We’re not able to accept PayPal, check or bank transfer payments. Learn more about our accepted payment methods.

8
Does Buffer offer a free trial?

Yes, Buffer offers a free trial on our Team plan for 14 days. During the trial, you can change your plan type at anytime, including paying for a plan or opting for a Free plan.

9
What happens at the end of a Buffer trial?

If you'd like to move ahead with the subscription at the end of your trial, you can enter your credit card details under Billing Method. If you don't want to upgrade to a paid plan at the end of your trial and you haven't entered your credit card details, your account will automatically be downgraded to the Free plan.

10
After the trial ends, will scheduled posts still go out?

Yes, scheduled posts will continue to go out after the trial ends, as long as the connected social channel is not locked. However, the Free plan has a 10 post queue limit (you won’t be able to schedule more than 10 posts on your unlocked channels). Locked channels will not be usable, but they will automatically unlock if you upgrade to a paid plan with space for those channels. For more info, head here.

11
Will I lose anything when I move from trial to subscription?

The transition from trial to subscription is seamless, and all of your connected social channels, scheduled posts, analytics, and reports will remain in place. That’s the case if you move from a trial to a free or paid plan.

12
Can I keep my three free channels if I upgrade from Buffer’s Free plan to a paid plan?

You won't be able to keep your three free channels if you upgrade to one of the Essentials plans. This is because we can't run two plans on a single account, and every channel you have connected will be upgraded. However, the good news is that your existing three channels will now allow up to 2,000 posts. Plus, you’ll get access to full analytic reports, engagement tools and a number of other great benefits depending on the channel type.

13
What is the scheduled post limit for the Free plan?

The scheduled post limit for the Free plan is 10 per social channel. Once a scheduled post gets published, another slot becomes available, up until the maximum of 10 scheduled posts per social channel is reached.

14
What is the scheduled post limit for the Essential, Team and Agency plans?

The scheduled post limit for the Essentials, Team and Agency plans is 2,000 per social channel.

15
Is the scheduled post limit a daily, weekly, or monthly limit?

The posting limit is not based on a time period. Instead, it refers to the number of posts you can have scheduled in your queue at any one time, for each channel.

16
Does Buffer offer a discount for nonprofits?

Yes, Buffer is proud to offer a 50% discount to nonprofits. Learn more here.

17
What is Start Page?

Start Page is a feature that allows users to create a beautiful landing page featuring your most important links and calls to action. It also offers publishing capabilities, allowing users to publish updates straight to their Start Page. Learn more here.

18
What is Buffer’s AI Assistant?

With the Buffer AI Assistant you can generate ideas in just a click and repurpose your existing content dozens of times, helping you grow your engagement across all social platforms. The AI Assistant is available on all plans, including the free plan, but there are limits on how many AI Credits each plan has. Every time you use the AI Assistant, an AI Credit is used.

19
Are Buffer's mobile apps and browser extensions available on the Free plan?

Yes, Buffer's mobile apps and browser extensions are available for all Buffer plans, including the Free plan. Our mobile apps are available on both iOS and Android platforms, while our browser extensions are available on Google Chrome, Firefox, and Safari.

20
When were the prices on Buffer's pricing page last updated?

The prices on Buffer's pricing page were last updated as of August 2021.

21
Does Buffer charge VAT to customers?

Buffer will be charging VAT to appropriate customers in the future. This is subject to taxes per your regional policies. Buffer supports exemption from tax processes where possible.

2Who is the Buffer Free plan ideal for?The Free plan is ideal for individual users who want to schedule content to up to three channels.3What does the Buffer Essentials plan offer?The Essentials plan is better suited for scheduling content to a brand's social channels and provides access to Buffer's advanced analytics and engagement tools.4Who should consider the Buffer Team plan?The Team plan is best for teams who want to collaborate on their social media posts and unlocks the ability to invite unlimited team members. However, it's not limited to teams only. Even if you're a solo social media marketer who needs someone to approve posts, the Team plan can be useful for getting your drafts approved. So, if you need help with approvals or want to collaborate with others on your social media content, the Team plan could be a great fit for you.5What is the Buffer Agency plan?The Agency plan is for organizations or individuals who want to connect 10 or more social channels and provides all the features of both the Essentials and Team plans at a lower price point. Agency plans start at $120 per month for up to 10 channels. Any additional channels connected after 10 would be priced at $6 a month (or $60 a year) instead of $12.6What are the billing options for Buffer's plans?You can choose to pay for your plan on a monthly or annual basis. Opting for the annual billing option comes with a discount. You can switch between these two options at any time. In the event that you switch billing frequencies, we will make prorations and refunds as necessary. 7What payment methods does Buffer accept?Buffer accepts credit and debit card payments from Visa, Mastercard, American Express, JCB, Discover, and Diners Club. We’re not able to accept PayPal, check or bank transfer payments. Learn more about our accepted payment methods.8Does Buffer offer a free trial?Yes, Buffer offers a free trial on our Team plan for 14 days. During the trial, you can change your plan type at anytime, including paying for a plan or opting for a Free plan.9What happens at the end of a Buffer trial?If you'd like to move ahead with the subscription at the end of your trial, you can enter your credit card details under Billing Method. If you don't want to upgrade to a paid plan at the end of your trial and you haven't entered your credit card details, your account will automatically be downgraded to the Free plan.10After the trial ends, will scheduled posts still go out?Yes, scheduled posts will continue to go out after the trial ends, as long as the connected social channel is not locked. However, the Free plan has a 10 post queue limit (you won’t be able to schedule more than 10 posts on your unlocked channels). Locked channels will not be usable, but they will automatically unlock if you upgrade to a paid plan with space for those channels. For more info, head here.11Will I lose anything when I move from trial to subscription?The transition from trial to subscription is seamless, and all of your connected social channels, scheduled posts, analytics, and reports will remain in place. That’s the case if you move from a trial to a free or paid plan.12Can I keep my three free channels if I upgrade from Buffer’s Free plan to a paid plan?You won't be able to keep your three free channels if you upgrade to one of the Essentials plans. This is because we can't run two plans on a single account, and every channel you have connected will be upgraded. However, the good news is that your existing three channels will now allow up to 2,000 posts. Plus, you’ll get access to full analytic reports, engagement tools and a number of other great benefits depending on the channel type. 13What is the scheduled post limit for the Free plan?The scheduled post limit for the Free plan is 10 per social channel. Once a scheduled post gets published, another slot becomes available, up until the maximum of 10 scheduled posts per social channel is reached.14What is the scheduled post limit for the Essential, Team and Agency plans?The scheduled post limit for the Essentials, Team and Agency plans is 2,000 per social channel.15Is the scheduled post limit a daily, weekly, or monthly limit?The posting limit is not based on a time period. Instead, it refers to the number of posts you can have scheduled in your queue at any one time, for each channel.16Does Buffer offer a discount for nonprofits?Yes, Buffer is proud to offer a 50% discount to nonprofits. Learn more here.17What is Start Page?Start Page is a feature that allows users to create a beautiful landing page featuring your most important links and calls to action. It also offers publishing capabilities, allowing users to publish updates straight to their Start Page. Learn more here.18What is Buffer’s AI Assistant?With the Buffer AI Assistant you can generate ideas in just a click and repurpose your existing content dozens of times, helping you grow your engagement across all social platforms. The AI Assistant is available on all plans, including the free plan, but there are limits on how many AI Credits each plan has. Every time you use the AI Assistant, an AI Credit is used.19Are Buffer's mobile apps and browser extensions available on the Free plan?Yes, Buffer's mobile apps and browser extensions are available for all Buffer plans, including the Free plan. Our mobile apps are available on both iOS and Android platforms, while our browser extensions are available on Google Chrome, Firefox, and Safari.20When were the prices on Buffer's pricing page last updated?The prices on Buffer's pricing page were last updated as of August 2021.21Does Buffer charge VAT to customers?Buffer will be charging VAT to appropriate customers in the future. This is subject to taxes per your regional policies. Buffer supports exemption from tax processes where possible.
